_doc: One entry per shot, in timeline order. line = [first word, last word] as Whisper wrote them (punctuation ignored). head/tail = seconds kept before/after the line. zoom/cy = punch-in. events: ding {after}, banner {name, after, dur}, ding_at {take_time}, cutaway {take_time, take, in, dur, zoom, cy}. fixed = [in, out] for a silent span. out = absolute take time to end at. See references/edit-pipeline.md.

cuts.note: 1 CHAR1: Hey... I think we should break up.
2 CHAR2: reaction line with a punch-in
3 CHAR1: denial line, then DING + banner
